A Day with Willa & Coal

A TINY BAKERY BY DAY · A GLOWING FOREST BY NIGHT

By day, you help Willa and Coal run their tiny bakery, Coal's Kitchen. When night falls, you follow them into a forest that glows.

You'll face 8 little moments in one day. There are no right or wrong answers — just pick what your heart wants most. At the end of the night, the Owl will look at the day you've lived and give you a little personality card.

  • 1Run the little shop by day and welcome all kinds of guests
  • 2Wander into the forest at night and meet wonderful friends
  • 3Collect Warmth and Starlight, and see what type you are today
